_about: Skyscrapers layer, 150 m and taller (Toronto's cut-off), from Wikipedia's list. engine/fetch_skyscrapers.py fetches it; engine/skyscrapers.py builds docs/melbourne/data/skyscrapers.geojson. Table names are checked against the fetch log (cities/melbourne/raw/skyscrapers/fetch.log). The list covers Greater Melbourne, mostly the CBD, Southbank and Docklands. Wikipedia's 'under construction or approved' table lists only what is under construction or topped out on the map (approved and on-hold towers are left out by the engine). It gives no location: three are geocoded from their addresses below; BLVD and Aura (Melbourne Square, Southbank) and Atlas (La Trobe Street) have no published street number yet, so they are left out until one appears.
wiki: List of tallest buildings in Melbourne

open._rule: A tower listed with this year's date is drawn hollow (under construction) unless marked true here: it must be open for occupancy, not just topped out.
